The drainage at Jewel Crossing has been a problem since the day my mother moved in last summer, and the property managers are aware of the situation and have yet to do anything about it. I know from speaking with neighbors that more than one other resident has tried to approach management about the standing water/drainage problem, but they don't seem concerned.
